indicators.name: Broad fingerprint profile
indicators.description: A page queried navigator, screen, and font characteristics during the same visit.

indicators.name: Repeated font probing
indicators.description: A page used font-probing signals at least ten times.

indicators.description: A page used credential, peripheral, or local file-system APIs.

indicators.name: Advertising privacy API use
indicators.description: A page used Topics, Protected Audience, or Shared Storage.
